costs.biased_source: Block arity, gate synthesis and clock/control grow with L; majority needs at least L-1 nearest-neighbor depth and rotation needs L-1 SWAPs. The biased source has extensive entropy deficit, and correlated later states make fresh preparation/reset non-free.
costs.finite_patch: The locality tail eta_ell, bath term nu_lambda, source preparation, device/bath norm, dimension, bandwidth and finite-shot resources must be charged or acquired; none is established here.
costs.tracial_source: The maximum-error threshold is O(r^-6) at fixed local dimensions and the disjoint-band mean lower bound is O(r^-7); the explicit selector is O(r^-1), leaving a gap. Affordable acquisition is not established.
